comparison: Canonical decimal strings, UUID spelling, identities and frames also compare bytes via the package digest; ordinary JSON round trips compare structure. Defaults and additive replies compare to production-normalized structure recorded in expected_reencoded.
digest: SHA256SUMS hashes raw bytes, sorted relative paths, excludes itself and DIGEST; DIGEST hashes SHA256SUMS
encoding: UTF-8; JSON files end in LF; frame files are raw wire bytes
scope: Wire syntax and explicit validator results only. No native authentication, filesystem existence, Job, authority admission, or liveness claim. Cross-platform consumer vectors use typed serialization then explicit platform-field mutations and validate on the corresponding native build. UUID freshness vectors rebase a fixed reference clock to production wall time before validation. Pipe digest vectors pin the SID-NUL-canonical-path hash recipe, not native canonicalization/authentication.
